canonical_speed_population.endpoint: log overall post-initiation migration speed using the same expert-corrected migration==TRUE definition as analysis/12_post_initiation_speed.py

heterogeneity.method: inverse-variance Cochran Q on project-specific ordinal Durif log-speed coefficients

interpretation: There is no evidence in these six projects that the Durif-stage effect on post-initiation overall speed differs more among projects than expected from sampling error.
The pooled near-null stage effect is therefore not explained by strong detectable sign-changing project heterogeneity within this analysis universe.
This does not establish that stage is irrelevant to all progression metrics or all rivers.

external_boundary.source: Moyo et al. 2026 Hydrobiologia, River Test
external_boundary.note: A separate reach-level mixed model retained silvering stage during model selection for downstream progression rate. Its endpoint, design and stage coding differ from the six-project overall-speed analysis, so it is a boundary case rather than a direct contradiction.

claim_boundary: Supported: strong transferable activation association plus weak general effect on this six-project overall-speed endpoint. Not supported: universal disappearance of silvering effects after activation, or a demonstrated project-context interaction in the six-project data.
